summary: Unlock your potential with our Advanced Financial Modeling Training. Gain expertise in financial analysis and modeling techniques for real-world applications.
lede: Financial analysis and modelling training covers forecasting and valuation for finance professionals who have mastered spreadsheet basics. Learners build integrated three-statement models, create multi-stage discounted cash flow valuations, and use scenario and sensitivity analysis to test assumptions and assess risk. Practical exercises also cover debt and equity schedules for acquisition and leveraged buyout models.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for finance professionals who have mastered basic spreadsheet functions and now require the technical depth to lead complex valuation and forecasting initiatives.
modules: Advanced Excel and Data Engineering for Finance
prerequisites: Participants should have a strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas (SUM, IF, VLOOKUP) and pivot tables. A foundational understanding of corporate finance principles, including the relationship between the three financial statements, is required. No prior programming or VBA experience is necessary, though familiarity with financial accounting standards (IFRS or GAAP) is highly recommended.
